What exactly is AI slop anyway? How do you actually define it? Who is behind it all? And what does it mean for the human storytelling that we care about? We journey deep into the muck, and fight our way back out with answers. Shell Game is a multiple award-winning series that has been named one of the best of the year by Apple, The Atlantic, The Guardian, Vulture, The Information, The Economist. It's "riveting," says The New Yorker, "awesome" says The Verge, "slightly terrifying," says The Globe and Mail, and “a dry, funny plunge down the rabbit hole that pokes at something essential about the hours we spend on this earth,” says Vulture. www.shellgame.co This show includes AI-generated content.

Each episode explores AI, Quantum, Space, Health, Learning, Energy, Robotics, Business and leadership, and Angelic Intelligence. This isn't a show about gadgets. It's about you and the choices we make today that decide whether technology makes humanity smaller or makes us superhuman. From the quantum scale to the edge of the cosmos, no hype. Just the people building tomorrow, today. Subscribe for Updates.
